proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for ubooquity, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the ubooquity service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the ubooquity
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  ubooquity:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.ubooquity.loadbalancer.server.port=2202
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity.rule=Host(`ubooquity.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity.service=ubooquity
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity.middlewares=authentik@docker
      - traefik.http.services.ubooquity-extra1.loadbalancer.server.port=2203
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity-extra1.rule=Host(`ubooquity.example.com`) && PathPrefix(`/admin`)
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity-extra1.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity-extra1.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity-extra1.service=ubooquity-extra1
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity-extra1.priority=90
      - traefik.http.services.ubooquity-extra2.loadbalancer.server.port=2203
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity-extra2.rule=Host(`ubooquity.example.com`) && PathPrefix(`/admin-res`)
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity-extra2.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity-extra2.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity-extra2.service=ubooquity-extra2
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity-extra2.priority=90
      - traefik.http.services.ubooquity-extra3.loadbalancer.server.port=2203
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity-extra3.rule=Host(`ubooquity.example.com`) && PathPrefix(`/admin-api`)
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity-extra3.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity-extra3.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity-extra3.service=ubooquity-extra3
      - traefik.http.routers.ubooquity-extra3.priority=90

kubernetes:
# Ubooquity: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-ubooquity/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: ubooquity-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ubooquity
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: ubooquity-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ubooquity
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: ubooquity-books
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ubooquity
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: ubooquity-comics
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ubooquity
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: ubooquity-files
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ubooquity
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ubooquity
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ubooquity
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: ubooquity
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: ubooquity
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ubooquity
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/ubooquity:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: ubooquity-env
        ports:
        - name: port-2202
          containerPort: 2202
          protocol: TCP
        - name: port-2203
          containerPort: 2203
          protocol: TCP
        volumeMounts:
        - name: ubooquity-config
          mountPath: /config
        - name: ubooquity-books
          mountPath: /books
        - name: ubooquity-comics
          mountPath: /comics
        - name: ubooquity-files
          mountPath: /files
      volumes:
      - name: ubooquity-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: ubooquity-config
      - name: ubooquity-books
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: ubooquity-books
      - name: ubooquity-comics
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: ubooquity-comics
      - name: ubooquity-files
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: ubooquity-files
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: ubooquity
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ubooquity
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ubooquity
  ports:
  - name: port-2202
    port: 2202
    targetPort: 2202
    protocol: TCP
  - name: port-2203
    port: 2203
    targetPort: 2203
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# ubooquity.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-ubooquity/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Ubooquity (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/ubooquity:latest
ContainerName=ubooquity
AutoUpdate=registry
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
# Environment=MAXMEM=
Volume=/path/to/ubooquity/data:/config:Z
Volume=/path/to/books:/books:Z
Volume=/path/to/comics:/comics:Z
Volume=/path/to/raw/files:/files:Z
PublishPort=2202:2202
PublishPort=2203:2203

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
